 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct spelling is 'Cemetery'.**
 
• The word '**Cemetery**' is a **noun** that refers to a burial ground or graveyard. **(कब्रिस्तान)**
 
• It is often used to describe a place where the dead are buried.

**Correct Usage:** The cemetery was located at the edge of the town, surrounded by tall trees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Common misspellings:**
 
 
• **Cemetary:** Incorrect spelling, often used due to phonetic similarity.
 
• **Cemetry:** Incorrect spelling, missing a critical "e".
 
• **Semetary:** Incorrect spelling, often a typo or misunderstanding of the original word.
 
 
 
• **Mnemonic to Remember:** Think of "Cemetery" as having three "e"s, just like the word "rest" (as in resting place).
